references.text: Refers to the spirit of jealousy that comes over a man; the same expression 'ruach qin'ah' (ר֥וּחַ קִנְאָ֖ה) is used here as in verse 30
Introduces the entire law concerning the jealousy offering, which verse 30 summarizes and concludes
Describes the penalty for adultery under Israel's law, which the jealousy ritual was meant to uncover
The principle of bringing difficult cases before the Lord and the priests for judgment
Describes jealousy as a man's fury and highlights the seriousness of suspicion regarding infidelity
